name: Eyes of Lex
source:
Lex is just an ordinary 22-year-old girl. Well, aside from the fact that she's aware she exists within a visual novel. Even worse, she has dyslexia, which makes reading dialogue a very tedious task for her. Nevertheless, she's in need of a friend, one who can see things from her perspective. Might you be that friend?

[From [url=https://mettaseven.itch.io/eyes-of-lex]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
Lex只是一个普通的22岁女孩。好吧，除了她知道自己存在于视觉小说中这一事实之外。更糟糕的是，她患有阅读障碍，这使得阅读对话对她来说是一项非常乏味的任务。然而，她需要一个朋友，一个能从她的角度看问题的朋友。你可能是那个朋友吗？

[来自[url=https://mettaseven.itch.io/eyes-of-lex]Itch.io[/url]]
